model.title: National Wildlife Refuge System Invasive Species Strike Team Act of 2025
model.meta: Natural Resources Committee · Rep. Ed Case (D-HI)

summary.text: The bill would establish statutory authority for an existing program that coordinates teams across different regions of the National Wildlife Refuge System to tackle invasive species problems. It would require the Fish and Wildlife Service to report to Congress on the program's progress in addressing invasive species that threaten the environment, human health, or the economy.
